$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0. A suggested way forward for property packs in England. One worked proposal - not a standard, and endorsed by nobody.
title: Property pack component register
description: One suggested decomposition of an English residential property pack into 27 named components, each with a permanent identifier, a supply code, the best verification level reachable for it today, its expiry semantics, and the primary source it is drawn from.
disclaimer: This is a suggestion, not a standard. This register is one worked proposal for how a residential property pack in England could be decomposed. No government department, regulator, accreditation body or trade association has endorsed it. Nothing here is required of anyone, and nothing here describes what a property pack will contain - only what one could contain.

fieldNotes.lastCheckedAt: When the regulatory position recorded in this file was last checked. Inherited from the source analysis and not independently re-verified since.
fieldNotes.sourceUrlsResolvedAt: When every sourceUrl in this file was last confirmed to resolve. A different fact from lastCheckedAt, and deliberately a separate field. Conflating the two is the error this project most wants to avoid.
fieldNotes.status: The legal status of the instrument or source at this row's sourceUrl, as it bears on this component. It is NOT a claim about the status of property pack requirements in general, which are announced-policy throughout. Where a row's source is an operative public dataset rather than a statute, in-force reads as: this source is operative today.
fieldNotes.bestVerificationToday: A ceiling, evaluated today: the highest verification level reachable for this component now, not the level any particular record will carry. Where the ceiling is conditional, verificationNote records the condition.
fieldNotes.packSide: sales for the 21 components of an anticipated sales pack; rental for the 6 components of the landlord-facing evidence set.

supply.3P: Requires a third party to respond

verificationLevel.ownerDeclared: The owner typed it. Useful, not authoritative.
verificationLevel.professionallyVerified: A surveyor, assessor, engineer or installer supplied it.
verificationLevel.unknown: Explicitly unknown. A first-class state, not a null.

legalStatus.in-force: Law today, commenced, enforceable - or, for a dataset, operative today.
legalStatus.enacted-not-commenced: On the statute book, awaiting commencement regulations.
legalStatus.announced-policy: Government has stated intent; requires future legislation.
legalStatus.consultation-stage: Consultation announced or open; content not settled.
legalStatus.locally-discretionary: Exists, but varies by local authority and date.

expiryKind.stable: Does not expire in normal circumstances.
expiryKind.hard: A dated expiry on the face of the document or certificate.
expiryKind.soft: No legal expiry, but treated as stale after a conventional period.
expiryKind.periodic: Reviewed or reissued on a cycle.
expiryKind.append-only: Never expires; new entries are appended.
expiryKind.on-change: Valid until the underlying fact changes.
expiryKind.point-in-time: A snapshot, valid only for the moment it describes.
expiryKind.per-event: Tied to a transaction, tenancy or registration rather than to a date.

mvpPrefill.yes: Can be pre-filled free from public data.
mvpPrefill.partly: Can be partly pre-filled, or pre-filled but requiring owner confirmation.
mvpPrefill.no: Cannot be pre-filled; supplied by the owner, a professional or a third party.
mvpPrefill.not-yet: The source is not operational yet. Build the fields, flag them off.

packSide.sales: Part of an anticipated sales pack.
packSide.rental: Part of the landlord-facing rental evidence set.

notes.note: statutoryRegisterVerified is reachable by no row in this register today, and is retained deliberately. The enum describes kinds of evidence, not available feeds. It remains the correct label for the PRS Database the day that register becomes operational, and removing it now would mean a breaking change to a published interchange format then. An unused enum value costs nothing; an absent one costs a breaking change.

licensing-status is locally-discretionary. Selective, additional and mandatory HMO licensing designations are made council by council. For most addresses no curated register exists, and the honest output is uncertain plus a link to the relevant council - not a guess.

Of the 21 sales-side components, 9 are pre-fillable free from public data, 6 are owner-supplied, 4 need a paid professional and 2 need a third party to respond. The 6 that cannot be self-supplied stay in any completeness denominator rather than being excluded to flatter the total.

components.name: HM Land Registry title information and documents

components.name: Standard searches: local authority, environmental, drainage and water

components.name: Property condition report

components.name: Leasehold and freehold estate terms

components.name: Building safety information

components.verificationNote: professionallyVerified on a response. Applies to in-scope buildings.

components.name: Gas safety record

components.verificationNote: The document was produced by a professional. The claim that it is genuine and belongs to this property is the uploader's.

components.name: Electrical Installation Condition Report

components.verificationNote: The document was produced by a professional. The claim that it is genuine and belongs to this property is the uploader's.

components.name: Smoke and carbon monoxide alarm declaration
Property licensing status
components.verificationNote: sourceMatched only where a council publishes a curated register. For most addresses no such register exists, and the honest output is uncertain plus a link to the relevant council.

components.name: Private rented sector database landlord and dwelling identifiers
components.verificationNote: The register is not operational, so no verification level above unknown is reachable for this component today. It would become statutoryRegisterVerified once the database is live - the only row in this register that could ever reach that level at present.
